comment: Pinned compiler. The builder downloads exactly this file and refuses any other bytes. zig is MIT-licensed (https://ziglang.org); it bundles clang/lld (Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception), libc++ and mingw-w64. Mirrors carry the same file; the SHA-256 is what is trusted, not the server. zig_linux: the same zig for a Linux host (the builder on Linux / Steam Deck); it cross-compiles the same Windows exe and the native Linux ELF.
